papers.title: Effect of solution heat treatment on microstructure and mechanical properties of laser powder bed fusion produced cobalt-28chromium-6molybdenum

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了激光粉末床熔融CoCrMo合金的固溶热处理对微观结构和力学性能的影响，属于生物医学植入物材料的基础背景研究，但缺乏多孔结构或骨整合相关分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue performance, or osseointegration, which are central to the AM Biomedical Materials direction.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究固溶热处理对LPBF钴铬钼合金显微组织和力学性能的影响。
summary_zh.method: 对LPBF成型的CoCrMo合金进行不同固溶热处理，并进行显微组织和力学性能表征。
summary_zh.result: 固溶热处理显著影响显微组织和力学性能，优化后性能提升。
summary_zh.validation: 通过拉伸、硬度等力学测试验证热处理效果。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of solution heat treatment on the microstructure and mechanical properties of laser powder bed fused CoCrMo alloy for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Solution heat treatments at various temperatures were applied to LPBF-produced CoCrMo specimens, followed by microstructural analysis and mechanical testing.
summary_en.result: Heat treatment significantly altered the microstructure (e.g., grain size, phase distribution) and improved mechanical properties such as strength and ductility.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical tests including tensile and hardness measurements were performed to validate the effect of heat treatment.

papers.title: The Influence of Obesity on Hip Pain, Function, and Satisfaction 10 Years Following Total Hip Arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Physiotherapy Department, Sir Charles Gairdner Hospital, Nedlands, Western Australia, Australia

corresponding_authors.name: Samantha Haebich
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Physiotherapy Department, Sir Charles Gairdner Hospital, Nedlands, Western Australia, Australia

llm.relevance_to_user: 与研究方向无关，为临床疗效研究，不涉及生物力学建模或应力遮挡分析。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or any finite element analysis; it is a clinical outcomes study without biomechanical modeling or implant mechanics analysis.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究肥胖对全髋关节置换术后10年疼痛、功能及满意度的影响。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性队列研究，收集患者报告结果评分。
summary_zh.result: 肥胖患者术后效果较差，但整体满意度相似。
summary_zh.validation: 临床随访数据，统计学比较组间差异。

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the impact of obesity on long-term patient-reported outcomes after total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Retrospective cohort study analyzing patient-reported outcome measures at 10-year follow-up.
summary_en.result: Obese patients showed worse pain and function scores but similar satisfaction compared to non-obese patients.
summary_en.validation: Clinical follow-up data with statistical comparisons between BMI groups.

papers.title: Simulation of the temperature distribution and solidified bead in single-pass selective laser melting using a mesh-free method
papers.abstract: The distribution of temperature and the formation of a solidified bead have considerable influence on single-pass selective laser melting (SLM). In this study, a transient three-dimensional numerical model is developed to simulate the evolution of the temperature field and the solidified bead by using smoothed-particle hydrodynamics, and the influences of processing parameters such as laser power, scanning speed, porosity, and thickness of the powder layer are studied and analyzed. The results show that the solidified bead forms as the powder material melts, and its shape changes from initially planar to a semicylindrical track because of the influence of the surface tension in the scanning process. Meanwhile, there is a discontinuous temperature distribution between the unmelted powder layer and the substrate material. Both the temperature distribution and the solidified bead deformation increase in the SLM process with the increase of the laser power and the porosity of the powder layer, but they both are apt to decrease with the increase of the scanning speed and the thickness of the powder layer. Experiments into the deformation distribution of the solidified bead and the dimensions of the molten pool are carried out under the same processing parameters, and the results are largely consistent with those from the simulation.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究选择性激光熔化的热模拟，不涉及生物医学植入物或应力遮挡。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on thermal simulation of the SLM process without any consideration of porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, or biomedical implant context.

summary_zh.motivation: 研究SLM中温度分布与凝固成型的影响因素
summary_zh.method: 采用SPH方法建立三维瞬态数值模型模拟温度场与凝固轨迹
summary_zh.result: 激光功率和粉末孔隙率升高会加剧温度分布与凝固变形，扫描速度与层厚增加则相反
summary_zh.validation: 实验验证了凝固轨迹变形与熔池尺寸，结果与模拟一致

summary_en.motivation: To understand the effects of processing parameters on temperature distribution and solidified bead formation in selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: A transient 3D numerical model using smoothed-particle hydrodynamics was developed to simulate the temperature field and solidification process.
summary_en.result: Increasing laser power and powder porosity raises temperature and bead deformation, while higher scanning speed and layer thickness reduce them.
summary_en.validation: Experimental measurements of bead deformation and molten pool dimensions under identical parameters confirmed the simulation results.
